adsetTakeaway: Video/Reels has produced most of the reported leads at a materially lower cost per lead. Static still contributes leads through the $47+gst ad and should not be dismissed.
creativeNote: The natural, personality-led video content is also the strongest paid performer so far. Keep creating and sharing authentic, useful organic content. Paid spend can then take the strongest ideas further, while the results show which messages deserve more creative variations.

findings.title: Video/Reels is leading
findings.body: Video/Reels has generated the majority of Meta-reported leads with a lower cost per lead than Static.

findings.title: A few ads are doing the work
findings.body: Refunding Users, 'i still get my wife to do it' and $47+gst account for nearly every reported lead. Other ads have had little spend, so it is too early to call them failures.

findings.title: How a lead is counted
findings.body: Meta reports a lead once someone submits the sign-up email within the same browser session as clicking the ad. If someone clicks on one device or browser and comes back later to sign up on another, Meta may not attribute that lead back to the ad, so the true number of people reached is likely a bit higher than reported here.

nextSteps.title: Shift budget from Static into Video/Reels
nextSteps.body: I'll shift some budget from the Static ad set into Video/Reels. After another stable or promising week, we can look to scale further.

nextSteps.title: Refresh creative before fatigue sets in
nextSteps.body: We're creating new ads now to bring in fresh creative before the current top performers start to fatigue.

nextSteps.title: Match leads to registrations
nextSteps.body: Reconcile Meta's Lead events with Lodg's completed registrations and subsequent activations before treating them as confirmed signups or increasing spend substantially.

nextSteps.title: Increase budget gradually
nextSteps.body: There is room to increase gradually, led by demonstrated results, rather than moving immediately to the full budget pace.
